anonymized_question_template: What is the gross margin percentage by category
sql_generated: SELECT p.category, (SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct FROM FACT_SALES s JOIN DIM_PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category
sql_final: SELECT p.category, (SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct FROM FACT_SALES s JOIN DIM_PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category
